recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missed half of the published Jira correction on an active build page without changing surrounding extension-registration guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-18376 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked the Extensibility examples text to say a FHIR StructureDefinition endpoint rather than a FHIR Profile endpoint, and to link the registry as the HL7 Registry.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GF#46c7a536b0. That 2018 commit updated the registry wording/link from HL7 Profile registry to a linked HL7 FHIR Registry label, but left the same sentence saying FHIR Profile endpoint.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml actively includes extensibility-examples.html under the Extensibility page, so this narrative source feeds the current build. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related final decision or community discussion that narrows or reverses the requested correction.
reconciliation: Updated source/extensibility-examples.html so the extension registration preference now names a FHIR StructureDefinition endpoint and uses the requested HL7 Registry link text.
source_changes: source/extensibility-examples.html: changed the extension registration preference from a FHIR Profile endpoint to a FHIR StructureDefinition endpoint and changed the linked registry label to HL7 Registry.
